Prebuilt psd_sdk artifacts — provenance & regeneration
======================================================

`fire_psd.lib` and `../src/bindings.rs` are PREBUILT, committed artifacts. This
crate links the `.lib` and includes the bindings directly; it does not compile
any C++ or run bindgen. That is deliberate: it keeps the 3D-Review workspace free
of a libclang/bindgen + C++ (`cl.exe`) build requirement for PSD support, matching
how the DXBC shader blobs and baked IBL maps are committed rather than rebuilt.

Underlying library
------------------
psd_sdk by Molecular Matters GmbH — https://github.com/MolecularMatters/psd_sdk
Vendored commit: f51449543273cbf12058ae92b230e0c4209f5066
License: BSD 2-Clause (see LICENSE, reproduced here as required for binary
redistribution). Only src/Psd/ (the library) is used.

fire_psd.lib
------------
An MSVC x64 static library: the psd_sdk `src/Psd/` sources plus a thin C-ABI
wrapper (`fire_psd_open` / `_info_get` / `_read_merged_rgba8` / `_free`, and unused
`_icc_*`). Built release-profile, so its objects link the release dynamic CRT
(`/MD` -> MSVCRT) and C++ STL (msvcprt) — the same CRT Rust's MSVC target links by
default, in both debug and release Rust builds. The linker pulls those in via the
`DEFAULTLIB` directives baked into the archive; no extra link flags are needed.

Regeneration
------------
The full `cc` + `bindgen` compile setup lives in fire's `psd-sdk-sys` crate
(D:\Dev\fire\crates\psd-sdk-sys). To refresh these artifacts after a psd_sdk
update or an ABI change to the wrapper:

  1. In the fire repo, from an "x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS":
       cargo build --release -p psd-sdk-sys
  2. Copy the outputs from
       fire/target/release/build/psd-sdk-sys-*/out/
     into this crate:
       fire_psd.lib  -> vendor/fire_psd.lib
       bindings.rs   -> ../src/bindings.rs

If the C-ABI wrapper surface changes, update crates/psd/src/lib.rs to match.
